entities.summary: West Bengal Socialist Party (WBSP) is a political party in the Indian state of West Bengal. WBSP was formed when the Bengali socialists in the then Janata Party split in the beginning of the 1980s. WBSP is a part of the Left Front. The party founder, Kiranmoy Nanda, was the Fisheries Minister in the Left Front government then.
